text:
Ash: Heads up — main turned red right after the merge at ~23:58. Smoke job failing: scheduler_integration.test_allocate (matrix shard 6).
CI-bot: Build 4221 failed: smoke/scheduler_integration (shard 6). Logs: http://ci/internal/build/4221 :rotating_light:
Priya: @Ash grabbing logs now, can you paste the last error lines?
Ash: sure, pasted below:
```
E 00:23:58 scheduler: allocation timeout after 30s
RuntimeError: KV alloc exceeded
  at allocator/alloc.py:213
  at scheduler/service.py:87
```
Morgan: I'll retry the build: `ci retry 4221 --shard 6`
Morgan: Done — queued rebuild 4222. ETA ~7m.
Jen: @Morgan if it flakes again can you start a bisect? I can open a revert if needed.
Priya: I saw a similar blip in canary earlier today — might be noisy autoscaler behavior. @Ravi any infra releases that could touch this?
Ravi: We shipped a small autoscaler threshold tweak yesterday (Eviction grace -> 12s -> 8s). Shouldn't hit CI but I'll double-check the rollout list.
Ash: quick metrics snapshot: alloc_ms median jumped 1523 -> 2134 around the failure window.
CI-bot: Rebuild 4222 started.
Morgan: Rebuild 4222 failed same test. Starting bisect: `ci bisect --range main~15..main --test=smoke/scheduler_integration`
Morgan: Bisect queued as job 17325.
Priya: Thanks — if bisect points at a recent CL (esp. anything landing in allocator) we should coordinate a revert.
Kelly: If it's my change I can hold new CLs and revert immediately.
Ravi: I'm going to add a temporary CI taint to reduce noisy autoscaler kicks while we triage — will open a quick PR.
Ash: :eyes: If bisect doesn't find a culprit in the last 10 commits we may need to drain and re-run whole pipeline.
Jen: Ack — ping me on results.
Morgan: Bisect finished — culprit commit 0x3a9 by Kelly. It introduces a race in allocator under high concurrent allocate. Repro locally with `--stress 8`.
Kelly: On it, sorry. I'll open a revert PR in ~10m and hold any further allocator changes.
Priya: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
CI-bot: Revert PR 7891 opened by Kelly. Tests queued.
Ash: Great, monitoring the queued runs. If flaky persists we escalate to SRE for a deeper look.
